recommendations.action: Install a fire-rated enclosure with automatic water spray around HX-C in HR-6 to prevent external fire heating tubes.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist; external fire causes polymer deposition/overheating leading to tube rupture. Passive fire protection removes the fire cause directly, preferred over detection/isolation which only mitigate consequence.

recommendations.action: Install a fire-rated enclosure with automatic water spray around the hydrogen recovery train equipment in HR-6 to prevent external fire impingement.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist; external fire causes thermal decomposition of chlorosilane polymers releasing toxic/flammable gases. Same fire protection as for C1 extends to all train equipment, removing the common cause.

recommendations.action: Add an engineered interlock on the washing area water inlet valve requiring confirmed STC purge (via pressure/temperature verification on HR-6 lines) before opening, keyed to PROC-Q-OPENING-4 and PROC-Q-OPENING-5 sequence.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist; operator error skipping steps allows water/STC contact. An engineered interlock prevents the hazardous valve operation independent of procedure adherence, superior to alarms or revised procedures.

recommendations.action: Implement sequenced valve interlocks: nitrogen purge valve interlocked to HX-B position/orientation sensors (enforcing PROC-Q-OPENING-3), and standby line valves interlocked to nitrogen blanketing pressure verification (enforcing PROC-Q-CHANGEOVER-1).
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist; two procedure step errors cause unscrubbed release and premature valve opening. Engineered interlocks enforce the critical sequence physically, preferred over procedural reliance or alarms.

recommendations.action: Install HX-B position/orientation sensors interlocked to the nitrogen purge start valve to enforce PROC-Q-OPENING-3 sequence, preventing purge before HX-B is in washing area upward orientation.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist; early nitrogen purge (PROC-Q-OPENING-3) releases unscrubbed gases. The interlock physically prevents the out-of-sequence start, directly closing the gap identified for this procedure section.

recommendations.action: Add mandatory independent valve position verification with physical interlocks on all block valves in PROC-Q-OPENING-1 through PROC-Q-OPENING-5 and PROC-Q-PRETREATMENT-1 through PROC-Q-PRETREATMENT-6 before HX-B opening.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist against valve mispositioning during opening/pre-treatment; an engineered interlock on the procedure steps removes the cause (operator/maintenance error) rather than relying on alarms or procedures alone.

recommendations.action: Add a material identity verification step (label check and composition confirmation) in PROC-Q-OPENING-1 before any charge/transfer to the humidifier section.
recommendations.reason: No layers protect against wrong material introduction during opening; verifying material at the procedural source (PROC-Q-OPENING-1) eliminates the cause before it reaches HX-B.

recommendations.action: Install a fire detection and automatic water deluge system covering the HR-6 chlorosilane polymer storage area.
recommendations.reason: No layers mitigate external fire impact on HR-6; an independent engineered fire suppression system acts on the deviation (external fire) before thermal decomposition occurs, preferred over procedural controls for external events.

recommendations.action: Add procedural interlocks (signed sequential checklists with supervisor sign-off) to PROC-Q-OPENING-4, PROC-Q-OPENING-5, and PROC-Q-PRETREATMENT-4 to prevent step skipping or reordering.
recommendations.reason: No layers address procedure step errors; interlocks at the specific failing steps enforce correct sequence, removing the operator error cause more reliably than alarms alone.

recommendations.action: Install a limit switch on the manual wash-water outlet block valve interlocked with HP-JET-PUMP start circuit to prevent pump operation when valve is closed, and add a pressure relief valve on the wash-water line downstream of HP-JET-PUMP.
recommendations.reason: No layers protect against pump running against closed valve or overpressure; the limit switch removes the cause (valve left closed) by preventing pump start, and the relief valve provides independent overpressure protection for the wash line.

recommendations.action: Install a standby HP-JET-PUMP with automatic changeover on low-flow detection in wash water line S-L-HP-WASH to maintain flow to HX-B during pump trip.
recommendations.reason: No protection layers exist for pump stop; a standby pump provides an independent engineered layer that removes the cause of flow loss, preferred over alarms or procedures.

recommendations.action: Add differential pressure monitoring across HX-C tube and shell sides with automatic isolation valves on both sides upon tube rupture detection.
recommendations.reason: No layers credited for tube rupture; differential pressure detection with automatic isolation is an independent engineered layer that limits release, preferred over procedural checks.

recommendations.action: Install inline composition analyzers on DRAINAGE-TANK-FACILITY feed lines with automatic diversion valves that isolate NaOH-containing streams when gas-gas exchanger residues are present.
recommendations.reason: No layers for incompatible chemical mixing; composition monitoring with automatic diversion is an engineered layer that prevents the cause (NaOH contact), preferred over procedural verification.

recommendations.action: Fit a keyed mechanical interlock on valve PROC-Q-OPENING-1 that only permits opening to S-OFFGAS-WATER-TANK after material identity verification via a coded key.
recommendations.reason: No layers for operator error charging wrong material; a mechanical interlock is an engineered layer that removes the human-error cause, preferred over alarms or procedures.

recommendations.action: Add a hardwired permissive interlock that only allows PROC-Q-OPENING-1 (HX-B opening) to proceed when flow is confirmed on PROC-Q-OPENING-3 (NaOH scrubber feed).
recommendations.reason: No layers for simultaneous scrubber flow loss and wrong material release; an interlock linking the two procedures is an engineered layer that prevents the combination, preferred over independent alarms.

recommendations.action: Replace temporary hose L-N2-HOSE-UPPER with a permanent nitrogen supply line to HX-B, incorporating a moisture trap and an automatic isolation valve on the nitrogen inlet that closes on high moisture detection.
recommendations.reason: Eliminates the leak path from the temporary hose and lightning damage to HR-6, and adds an engineered barrier that stops humidified nitrogen from reaching chlorosilane polymers in HX-B.

recommendations.action: Install a pressure interlock on the exchanger removal flanges that physically prevents bolt removal until an independent pressure transmitter verifies zero pressure in the isolated line.
recommendations.reason: Directly prevents exchanger removal while the line is pressurised due to a valve left open in PROC-Q-CHANGEOVER-2, replacing reliance on procedural compliance with a hardware interlock.

recommendations.action: Implement a keyed interlock sequence: completion of pre-treatment step 1 (dry nitrogen blow per PROC-Q-CHANGEOVER-1) releases a trapped key required to unlock the tooling for step 4 (removal of L-shaped outlet pipe and lower channel cover per PROC-Q-CHANGEOVER-4).
recommendations.reason: Enforces the required procedural order and nitrogen blanketing by engineered means, preventing step 4 execution if step 1 is skipped or incomplete.

recommendations.action: Install an automated hydrolysis verification system (e.g., HCl concentration analyzer on HX-B vent) interlocked with PROC-Q-PRETREATMENT-5 that must confirm low HCl levels before permitting exchanger opening.
recommendations.reason: Ensures the 20-day humidified nitrogen hydrolysis is complete and polymers are conditioned, independent of operator action on PROC-Q-PRETREATMENT-5, before opening the exchanger.

recommendations.action: Install a check valve on the wash-water line to prevent nitrogen backflow, and a pressure-switch interlock that blocks the wash-water pump start unless the wash-water outlet valve is confirmed open.
recommendations.reason: Prevents nitrogen contamination of wash water from valve mispositioning in PROC-Q-OPENING-3 and prevents pump operation against a closed outlet valve in PROC-Q-OPENING-2, eliminating both cause and consequence.
